column1: # One row per key the suite can type: token (Vim notation), Godot keycode,
# physical keycode, unicode, modifiers (S for Shift, - for none). US layout.
# Modifier prefixes such as <C-x> or <S-Tab> are added from the token.
# A cargo test feeds every row to translate_key and compares the result
# with vim-core's parse of the token.
